direction.summary: Native Vulkan workbench from canonical reusable modules, shared controls, one Handshake GPU owner, diagnostics wired from the beginning
boundaries: Observe owns shared diagnostic ports; kernel-bindings owns host-neutral bridges; Native/AppState/SurrealDB adapters stay in Handshake
One set of typed control descriptors feeds GUI, structured model tools, AccessKit, UserManual and Argus; stable control/action IDs; independent operator/model views
Attribution on every command: actor/session, command, document revision, trace/correlation; correlation never grants permission
Studio's registered business-event identities (22 FR-EVT-STUDIO-*) emitted by the binding, never substituted by generic diagnostics
Bounded jobs, queues, allocations, retained results; overload, cancellation, stale-revision and release defined; real-time callbacks use preallocated handoff
Mechanical diagnostics content-free: codes, counters, timing, opaque ids
One authoritative Handshake GPU owner: admission, budgets, truthful retained-memory accounting; in-flight ownership settles before release
Kernel-owned Vulkan init for login screen and app shell only; protected content and model work need current grants
Acceptance: genuine native Vulkan workflows and an independent watcher surviving a controlled owned-app freeze/crash
